official.deadline_note: Admission application deadline for Qatari and resident applicants who wish to apply for funding is 15 March 2027.
official.status_note: HBKU's Graduate Admissions page lists the online graduate admission application as open to the public from 1 October 2026; scholarships are considered during the admissions process with no separate application.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Tuition waivers are standardized across HBKU: PhD STEM (CSE and CHLS) 100%; PhD SHAPE and S.J.D. (CIS, CHSS, and CL) 100%; STEM MS programs (CSE and CHLS) 75%; SHAPE MS and MA programs (CIS, CHSS, and CPP) and J.D. (CL) 60%; LL.M. programs (CL), MS Economics (SEM) and certificate programs 0%. Self-sponsored graduate students are only eligible for a discounted tuition rate of 2,000 QAR per credit hour based on financial need.
benefits: Monthly stipend paid directly to the student: Qatari PhD 11,000 QAR/month (132,000 QAR annual rate); international PhD 9,000 QAR/month (108,000 QAR annual rate); local PhD 5,000 QAR/month (60,000 QAR annual rate); Qatari Master's 9,000 QAR/month (108,000 QAR annual rate); international Master's 7,000 QAR/month (84,000 QAR annual rate); local Master's 4,000 QAR/month (48,000 QAR annual rate)
Stipend duration of 45 months for PhD programmes and 21 months for Master's programmes
Tuition waiver applied to reduce tuition costs at the programme's standardized rate, from 100% for PhD programmes to 0% for LL.M. programmes, MS Economics and certificate programmes
Teaching Assistant service for 10 hours per week at an hourly rate of 50 QAR for the duration of the semester in which the student is assigned to teach
Paid employment through the Student Employment Program for up to 10 additional hours per week beyond the RA commitment
International students are provided a single round-trip airfare during their candidature: one inbound ticket upon starting the academic program and one outbound ticket upon graduation
eligibility: Admitted or applying HBKU graduate student; scholarships are considered during the admissions process
Tuition waivers and stipend awards depend on the availability of funds and are only awarded on a merit or need basis; they are not guaranteed
Stipends are awarded to full-time graduate students who are serving at the university as research assistants and/or teaching assistants
Full-time working professionals and part-time workers who exceed 40% of full-time hours are not eligible for stipends
Students must maintain good academic standing as specified in the scholarship agreement; scholarships are reviewed annually and depend on academic progress and available funds
Stipends funded from external sources, including research grants, are excluded from the published rates
requirements: Apply through the HBKU graduate admissions process; no separate scholarship application is needed
Students receiving a stipend shall work as research assistants with their primary supervisors for 10 hours per week
Work a maximum of 20 hours per week in total (i.e., 10 hours beyond the RA commitment)
Maintain good academic standing as specified in the scholarship agreement

Minimum 3.0 GPA out of 4.0 from a recognized university for College of Science and Engineering graduate programmes; a bachelor's degree for master's programmes and a master's degree for PhD programmes
Submit a valid IELTS score of 6.5 or a TOEFL score of 79 to demonstrate proficiency in English
documents: Completed online application form via the HBKU Apply Now portal

Official electronic copies of transcripts for all previous university studies, including an explanation of the grading system; transcripts in languages other than English or Arabic must be accompanied by an official translation

Official standardized test results where required, sent directly to HBKU (institutional codes: SAT 7675, GRE 7551, GMAT H6S, TOEFL 4981; for IELTS no code is required - students should ask the IELTS centre to send the TRF to HBKU)
Two letters of recommendation for postgraduate applicants, one of which must be from an academic referee
Personal statement of interest (300-500 words) explaining why the candidate is applying, personal objectives, research interests and achievements
Resume/curriculum vitae, an electronic copy of the passport (plus a valid Qatari ID for nationals and residents of Qatar), and a non-refundable application fee of QAR 250
selection_criteria: Scholarships are offered based on merit or financial need and available funds; they are not automatically awarded to admitted students
Strong academic record (minimum 3.0 GPA out of 4.0 for CSE graduate programmes)
Applicants with prior research experience are preferred, especially for the PhD programmes
Annual review of academic progress and continued availability of funds
coverage: Tuition waiver applied to reduce tuition costs, at a programme-specific standardized percentage
Monthly stipend paid directly to the student, described by HBKU as a fixed amount meant to cover general living expenses, including meals
Single round-trip airfare for international students during their candidature (one inbound ticket upon starting the academic program and one outbound ticket upon graduation)
TA pay at 50 QAR per hour for up to 10 hours per week when assigned to teach, and paid employment through the Student Employment Program for up to 10 additional hours per week

Housing is not covered: students are responsible for covering the cost of their housing, whether in QF dormitory facilities or external accommodations, paid from their monthly stipend or personal funds
application_method: Create a user account through the HBKU Apply Now portal
Submit an application by choosing the desired college and programme, with up to two applications permitted per academic year
After submission, log back into the account using the confirmation email instructions to submit supplementary documents and provide contact details for references
The HBKU admissions team checks the application for completion and eligibility before forwarding it to the relevant college for assessment
Await the college's decision and offer letter; scholarship notifications are sent by email
Scholarships are considered as part of the admissions process; no separate scholarship application is required
official.application_route: Apply for graduate admission through HBKU's online Apply Now portal; scholarship consideration happens within the admissions process and needs no separate application.
official.study_mode: Full-time (stipends are awarded to full-time graduate students)
official.citizenship_residency: Stipend rates are published separately for Qatari, local and international students; Qatari and resident applicants who wish to apply for funding have a later application deadline of 15 March 2027. Stipends for local students are limited.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - HBKU publishes dedicated international PhD and international Master's stipend rates and provides international students with a single round-trip airfare during their candidature.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Tuition waiver percentages are standardized by college and programme group: PhD STEM (CSE, CHLS) and PhD SHAPE/S.J.D. (CIS, CHSS, CL) 100%; STEM MS 75%; SHAPE MS and MA (CIS, CHSS, CPP) and J.D. 60%; LL.M. programmes, MS Economics and certificate programmes 0%.
official.research_requirement: Stipend recipients must serve as research assistants with their primary supervisors for 10 hours per week. Applicants to some CSE PhD programmes must submit GRE/GMAT at application (required for PhD in Sustainable Energy and PhD in Sustainable Environment; optional for PhD in Computer Science and Engineering), and applicants with prior research experience are preferred for PhD programmes.
official.duration: Stipend duration of 45 months for PhD programmes and 21 months for Master's programmes.
official.description: Graduate student scholarships at HBKU may include a tuition waiver applied to reduce the tuition costs for the students and a stipend paid directly to the student; generally, graduate students receiving a stipend would also be provided with a tuition waiver. Tuition waivers are standardized across HBKU, ranging from 100% for PhD STEM and PhD SHAPE/S.J.D. programmes to 0% for LL.M. programmes, MS Economics and certificate programmes.
official.english_requirement: Valid IELTS score of 6.5 or TOEFL score of 79 to demonstrate proficiency in English (published graduate admission requirement; further details about the language proficiency requirement and the process to seek exemption are available from HBKU admissions)

not_confirmed: Intake/cycle name (e.g. 2027/2028) for the round that opened on 1 October 2026 - the official pages publish dates only
College-specific English proficiency scores other than the published IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 79 graduate requirement
Stipend amounts for case-by-case exceptions - stipend exceptions require dean and provost approval and are decided individually
verification.notes: Stipend rates, waiver percentages, durations, RA/TA conditions, airfare and FAQ wording read directly from HBKU's official Scholarship Guidelines page; deadlines and application steps from the official Graduate Admissions and Admissions pages; English requirement, document list and admission criteria from HBKU's College of Science and Engineering graduate admissions page; headline funding_amount is the published international Master's monthly rate, with the full stipend table by category listed under benefits.

applicant_utility.summary: There is no separate scholarship form: HBKU considers you for a tuition waiver and stipend inside the graduate admissions process, so the admission file itself is the scholarship application and must be complete by the deadline. An international master's student on the published rates receives 7,000 QAR per month for 21 months plus a programme-specific tuition waiver (up to 75% for STEM MS, 60% for SHAPE MS/MA) and a single round-trip airfare, while PhD students receive higher rates over 45 months. The stipend is conditional on working 10 hours a week as a research assistant for your supervisor, caps total work at 20 hours per week, and must cover your housing and meals because HBKU pays no housing benefit. Treat the award as renewable rather than guaranteed: it is reviewed annually against academic progress and the availability of funds.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International students targeting a funded, full-time research master's or PhD at HBKU who can commit to weekly RA/TA service and want a Qatar-based research environment.
application_readiness_checklist: Submit through the Apply Now portal and upload every document in PDF only - non-PDF files are not accepted
Ensure each transcript includes an explanation of the grading system and an official translation if it is not in English or Arabic
Request two reference letters early, at least one from an academic referee, and enter their contact details after submitting
Write the 300-500 word personal statement well before the deadline and check the word count - incomplete or short statements are not accepted
Book IELTS/TOEFL early enough that scores are valid on 1 February 2027 and arrange for official score reports to reach HBKU
For CSE PhD programmes that require GRE/GMAT (Sustainable Energy, Sustainable Environment), schedule the test and send official scores directly to HBKU
common_rejection_risks: Applying to an LL.M., MS Economics or certificate programme expecting funding - these carry a 0% tuition waiver under the standardized rates
Being a full-time professional or working more than 40% of full-time hours, which rules out the stipend entirely
Missing the 1 February 2027 international deadline - the 15 March 2027 date applies only to Qatari and resident applicants seeking funding
Assuming admission guarantees money - awards are merit or need based, depend on available funds and are reviewed annually
Incomplete files: transcripts without grading-system explanations, untranslated documents, references not contacted, or extra materials that are automatically discarded
Holding external funding or sponsorship without checking the scholarship agreement first, since external funding may affect eligibility
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Housing in Qatar Foundation dorms or external accommodation, meals and general living costs (all paid from the 7,000 QAR/month stipend or personal funds), the QAR 250 non-refundable application fee, visa and residency costs, and any costs for dependants - the stipend does not vary with marital status or number of dependants.
document_audit: Transcripts must carry a grading-system explanation and, if not in English or Arabic, an official translation - missing either stalls the file
All uploads must be PDF; submitted documents cannot be returned, so verify each file before uploading
The personal statement must be 300-500 words covering motivation, objectives and research interests; shorter statements are rejected outright
The CV must list academic qualifications, professional experience, publications, research projects, academic awards or honours and conference presentations
Do not attach anything beyond the required list - additional materials are automatically discarded
For IELTS there is no institutional code: ask your test centre to send the TRF directly to HBKU
alerts: International applicants face the 1 February 2027 deadline, while Qatari and resident applicants seeking funding have until 15 March 2027 - confirm which category applies before relying on the later date
External funding may affect scholarship eligibility, and deferring admission may also affect it - contact your college before deferring
Stipends for local students are limited, and stipend exceptions beyond the published rates need dean and provost approval
The award is reviewed annually: keep academic standing strong and expect re-confirmation against available funds each year
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Create an account in the Apply Now portal, submit up to two programme applications with all required documents, then upload supplementary documents and reference contacts via the confirmation email while the admissions team and the college assess the file.
